tag: Episode 4 · The Abyss of Hae Water
title: The Abyss of Hae Water

beats.t: Splash. Their feet broke the surface. Then the world folded into blackness.
Cold, black, endless water. Strangely, Yeoni could breathe. That made it more frightening. Rather than falling, they were sinking very slowly, as though suspended in empty air.
My body's a feather, so why does my heart weigh a ton?
Only the small flower on their head shone like a living light beneath the water. Yeoni tried to clench a hoof. It still did not work well, but the warmth within it was distinct.
That little shoot. You're still here.
Yeongnyangi! Yeongnyangi, where are you!
No answer. Only black ripples moving slowly, without a word.
Above and below were equally dark. Distant lights drifted like old memories. Unread messages. Unsent sentences. Swallowed words. Moments when tears had risen, only to be laughed away.
They swam past Yeoni like little fish. Each brush of a fin chilled their skin.
Uh, that fish just swam past with something I'll cringe about in bed! Hey, that's my likeness! Get away!
What is this place... cloud storage for every embarrassing moment of my life?
Let me cancel the subscription. I only wanted the free trial.
A little bubble slipped out after the words. Blub. But there was writing inside it.
[ I'm fine. ]
The bubble did not rise. Instead, it sank heavily into the black water.
Hey, why is 'I'm fine' going down? Shouldn't it float if it's fine?
I'd like to file a bug report. Nothing in the terms said 'I'm fine will sink.' Did anyone QA this before release?
As though answering, more bubbles appeared in a string.
[ It's nothing. ]   [ I'm really fine. ]   [ I don't care. ]   [ Lol, I said I'm okay. ]
Yeoni's face stiffened. Every word was one they had said.
More precisely, words they used only on days when they were not fine at all.
One by one, the bubbles stuck to Yeoni's body. Then suddenly grew heavy as weights.
Wait, wait! What's happening!
Front legs! Back legs! Why are you all doing your own thing? A little teamwork!
All four short legs thrashed wildly underwater. Yet their body did not move forward an inch.
Pff—just inhaled a bucket through my nose. This pig snout has premium suction, I'll give it that.
This body is a complete package of defects. What kind of pig can't swim?
The flower overhead flickered. A green vine unfurled from inside a hoof. The power of Eul.
The vine pushed through the water. But the black water was too deep. Before long, it stopped.
Its tip wavered aimlessly, as though it did not know where to root.
I told you.
The reflected Yeoni emerged through the black ripples. Still human. Not wet, not a single hair out of place. So perfectly untouched it was chilling.
This is somewhere you can't enter.
How are you staying dry underwater? Waterproof coating?
Because I do not waver.
Wow, you are seriously obnoxious.
An involuntary snort bubbled from Yeoni's indignant nose. Oink. Half the menace vanished from the expression they had worked so hard to make.
That's your way of talking too.
...I've copyrighted that line. Stop using it.
The reflected Yeoni circled slowly, as though walking on level ground. Black water parted gently beneath each step.
This is the Abyss of Hae.
I know. Yeongnyangi told me.
Then you should understand. Eul is a shoot that needs water to live. But do you know what you're worst at in the world?
Yeoni could not answer. They opened their mouth, then closed it.
Going deep.
The reflected Yeoni flicked a finger, and a scene appeared in the black water like a strip of film.
Yeoni lying in bed with a phone. A chat with no reply. One sentence, written and erased, then written and erased again.
[ Actually... I was a little hurt. ]
The sentence never sent. It was erased, leaving only a cursor, then became a bubble and sank. Yeoni's throat tightened. It was that sentence, not the water, that made breathing hard.
Stop.
Why? It's your memory.
Another scene. Yeoni smiling brightly in front of friends.
“Oh, it's fine. I don't care about that sort of thing.”
Their face in profile as they turned away. The corners of their mouth were raised, but their eyes were not smiling at all.
The next scene. Dawn, after an entire assignment they had worked on all night vanished. Yeoni gave a small, lonely laugh at the empty screen.
“Wow. Legendary. My life really is a variety show.”
A few seconds later, the smile quietly disappeared. The sound of typing in the room stopped too.
The next scene. A text saying an interview was canceled. The message Yeoni sent a friend afterward.
“Lmao, my luck is wrecked again today lol.”
But below it, one sentence remained gray, its send button never pressed.
[ Honestly, I'm a little scared. What if things keep going this wrong? ]
Yeoni closed their eyes. They thought they had brushed it off. Thought laughter had carried them past it. But everything was here. Settled at the bottom of the black water, not one thing erased.
You always stop your sentences with laughter. You could say it hurts when it hurts, but you have to crack a joke first.
...Is that so bad?
Not bad. It's even funny.
But you never listen to your own feelings. Not once.
Yeoni had no answer. The black water grew heavy again. Bubbles clung all over their body.
[ I'm fine. ]   [ It's nothing. ]   [ I don't care. ]   [ That's just how I am. ]
Each bubble looked light as a feather. But the more that stuck, the heavier they became. Yeoni's body was dragged down and down.
Hey, dragging me to the deep sea for pretending I'm fine is a bit much, isn't it!
Pretending to be fine is the thing that sinks best.
Stop making quotable lines. I'm annoyed enough without you publishing a collection.
Then a very faint voice came from far away, as though descending from the surface.
Yeoni.

Far overhead, gold shimmered in the black water. Yeongnyangi. Unable to enter, he could only scrape the ripples with his claws from above. The Abyss of Hae Water was sealed water; outside power could not easily reach within.
Yeongnyangi! I'm completely submerged here! I don't even know which basement floor this is!
Don't push the water away! First, relax your body!
Then what? Introduce myself and tell the water I look forward to working together?
Introductions can wait.
Eul is Wood that grows by drinking water!
You already said that! Enough reruns!
Don't just think about it. Let your body feel the water!
The black water kept dragging Yeoni down. A vast pattern became faintly visible at the bottom. Curling waves. One character hidden at the center of their whirlpool.
Hae. But it was still on the bottom, beyond reach.
You can't go.
Is that seriously the only thing you can say?
I say you can't because you can't.
Ugh, brutal truths delivered with my own face are twice as infuriating.
My face, my voice, my way of talking. You have no idea how it feels to get beaten up by a whole matching set of facts.
Then prove it.
The reflected Yeoni reached out. The light of [乙] in Yeoni's hoof flickered like a candle.
However tightly you hold Eul, you cannot complete Eulhae without accepting Hae.
A flower cannot live without water. But you hate your own water.
My water?
Your deepest feelings. Those sentences you erase after watching the cursor blink.
Another scene appeared in the dark water. An unlit room. Yeoni sat alone, fiddling with a phone as though nothing was wrong. But the screen was off.
They were not looking at anything. Only staring blankly at their face reflected in the black screen. The Yeoni in that scene did not say one word. The silence hurt more than any scream.
Back then, I...
The words caught in their throat and never reached the end.
You were lonely.
The black water surged once.
And scared.
Another surge.
But you didn't tell anyone. Not a single person.
Bubbles rushed in all at once and enclosed Yeoni completely. The water rose to their neck.
[ I'm fine. ]   [ I can do it alone. ]   [ It doesn't bother me. ]   [ That's how it is for everyone. ]
Yeoni took a deep breath. Air came even underwater, but the center of their chest was blocked tight. That pressure was not the weight of water. It was the weight of everything endured for too long.
...Yes.
The bubbles stopped dead. The reflected Yeoni stopped circling too. Yeoni slowly raised their head and touched their chest with a wet hoof. Their heart was beating there.
I wasn't fine.
The words spread in rings through the water. One bubble burst. Pop.
[ I'm fine. ] ...Gone
I said it was nothing. But to me, it really was something.
Another burst. Pop.
[ It's nothing. ] ...Gone
I said I didn't care. Actually, it was all I thought about every night.
Pop. The black water grew a little lighter. A layer of weight lifted from their shoulders.
[ I don't care. ] ...Gone

Yeoni closed their eyes. This next sentence was the one they did not want to say. Speaking it felt as though it would make it real. But swallowing it felt as though they would remain on this bottom forever. Yeoni opened their eyes.
I was scared.
The entire black water heaved. For the first time, the reflected Yeoni's expression fell away.
I was scared things would keep going wrong. Scared I'd done something terribly wrong without knowing it.
I thought laughing it off would make me really okay. But I wasn't okay, and that scared me even more.
Bubbles began bursting everywhere. Pop. Pop. Pop. With each one, another small stretch of water cleared.
The character [亥] at the bottom sharpened, as though someone had wiped fog from glass.
Stop.
No.
Inside Yeoni's hoof, [乙] glowed warmly like a hand warmer. A green vine grew again.
This time it did not repel the water. It did not run. The vine slowly put down roots into the black depths, then trembled just a little, as though drinking water for the first time.

Yeoni felt it throughout their body. Not all the cold water was an enemy. It held loneliness, fear, words never sent. But it was not only water that meant to kill them. Because it existed, this tiny shoot could drink and grow.
Yes. ...That's it.
Hae is not water that exists to drown you. It holds a place where your roots can endure.
My roots...

The words landed strangely beneath Yeoni's ribs. They had always pretended to be bright, lighthearted, untroubled. Underneath, deep water had always gathered. Tiresome, heavy, cold water. Yet there were roots inside it.
Yeoni stretched out a hoof. The vine of [乙] reached straight toward [亥] at the bottom.
No! If you accept that—
I'll become more real than you?
The reflected Yeoni shut their mouth. Seeing that silence, Yeoni gave a little laugh.
Okay. No response means I got it right.
The vine's tip touched [亥]. A huge ripple spread in circles through the black water.
Cold water wrapped around Yeoni. But this time it did not drag them down. Instead, it lifted them as gently as two hands.
The character [亥] slowly rose. The black water turned the indigo of a deep sea at night. Within it, small stars lit one by one.
...Beautiful.

For the first time, Yeoni thought so. Water that had only frightened them began to look different. Cold, but clear. Dark, but not empty. It held memories, feelings, wounds, and a heart that had survived them all.
The flower above Yeoni's head opened fully. Two characters floated side by side before them, shining.
...The Eulhae Day Pillar.
As the words fell, the two characters joined in a single light. A green shoot rooted itself upon the deep water.
Then a small flower bloomed in the center of the black abyss. Absurdly small, but undeniably alive.
Yeoni held their breath at the flower. It looked just like them. Still weak, still small, still terribly frightened—yet alive.

Yeongnyangi's voice poured down from above. Golden claws parted the surface. Light rushed in like a waterfall. Yeoni rose. This time, instead of pulling them under, the water pushed their back upward.
You think finding Hae means it's over?
Probably not. Yeah, figured as much.
The Island of Companions isn't finished. Finding your roots and defending your place are entirely different things.
Then I'll go up and do that too. I'm starting to get the hang of this tutorial.
A tiny snort escaped at the end of the boast. Oink.
...Okay, I am still not used to that.
Light burst. Whoosh! Yeoni shot through the Abyss of Hae Water and rolled across the Island of Companions. Droplets flew everywhere.
Ow... Zero points for that landing.
...Still alive?
Yeoni slowly got up. The flower on their head shone incomparably more clearly than before. A blue wave pattern curled gently beneath it.
Eul and Hae have connected.
[ 乙亥 · Eulhae ]
They were no longer merely two characters. A small flower and deep water. A heart that wavered but did not die. The self that smiled brightly while carrying so much far beneath the surface.
Turns out I'm a more complicated type than I thought.
Only just realizing that?
Yep. But being complicated doesn't mean I'll give that fake my place. Not a chance.
All the island's mirrors shone together. The reflected Yeoni slowly walked out of the water.
The atmosphere was different this time. Black mirror fragments gathered beneath those feet. The eyes were colder, the voice lower.
Fine. ...Now let's begin the real test.
What? There's still another test?
Hey, when do the credits roll in this game? You keep inserting trials like paid DLC at every stage.
You have found Eulhae. But the Island of Companions insists on testing whether you can defend those characters too.

The reflected Yeoni raised a hand. Countless mirror shards floated behind like a folding screen. Each reflected a different Yeoni. Jealous Yeoni. Giving-up Yeoni. Yeoni comparing themself to others. Yeoni forcing a smile. Yeoni unable to trust even themself.
Come on, then. This time you must fight all those selves you believe you've already defeated.
Yeoni drew breath. A moment ago, fear would have come first. They were still afraid. But it was not quite the same fear. Eul's warmth rested in their hooves; Hae's water gathered deep in their chest.
Okay.
Yeoni looked their reflection straight in the eyes. The flower above their head shone brightly.
I just went all the way down to the abyss, you know. I've had a pretty major mental patch update.
The reflected Yeoni smiled without a sound.
[ Island of Companions · Final Trial Begins ]
